title: Velocity at entry
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the speed of rod a when it reaches the magnetic field boundary using work-energy theorem.

title: Speed at highest point
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law for circular motion to find rod b's speed at the top of the loop using the given normal force.

title: Energy conservation for rod b
description: Important: Uses conservation of mechanical energy to relate rod b's speed at the bottom of the loop to its speed at the top.

title: Momentum conservation
description: Essential: Applies conservation of linear momentum to the system of rods a and b during their interaction in the magnetic field.

title: Simultaneous equation solving
description: Important: Correctly solves the system of equations from momentum and energy to find the final speed of rod a.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (e.g., g, R) throughout the derivation and final answers.

title: Sign error in energy
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly signs the gravitational potential energy term in the conservation of energy equation for rod b.

title: Forgetting rod masses
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect masses (e.g., m instead of 2m) in the work-energy or momentum equations.
